**microcrawler-crawler-firmy-cz** is a project in [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md). Its code is written mainly in [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md) (100 %).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created in September 2019; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 2 March 2017. It reads “Fix problem with email address parsing”.
